diameterInterpretation: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 10.403 ± 0.259 km. Quoted fit error excludes about 10% survey systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects.

calibration.uncertaintyMeaning: Published statistical/Monte Carlo fit error; excludes the additional systematic term below.
calibration.systematicMeaning: Original publication reports approximately 10% additional systematic uncertainty in diameter. This is a population-level floor, not a shape-specific accuracy guarantee.
calibration.quantity: NEATM effective spherical diameter at the observing geometry
calibration.selectionReason: Selected fully cryogenic data when available; these data include W3 or W4 thermal measurements. Other survey epochs are retained separately.
calibration.formula: scaleKmPerSourceUnit = diameterKm / cbrt(6 * signedSourceVolume / pi); meterScale =1000*scaleKmPerSourceUnit. Original shape coordinates are preserved.
limitations: The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.
Quoted ±0.259 km is the catalog fit error; approximately 10% additional systematic diameter uncertainty applies.
calibration.visibleDescription: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 10.403 ± 0.259 km. Quoted fit error excludes about 10% survey systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects.

modelLimitations: The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved.
